description: KiwiSaver contributions (New Zealand) [NZ]. Works out yearly KiwiSaver contributions for 2026-27: the employee contribution, the employer contribution after employer superannuation contribution tax (ESCT), and the government contribution (25c per $1 up to $260.72 for members earning $180,000 or less). Assumes a full year of eligibility; part-year proration, temporary rate reductions and fund returns aren't covered.

eligibleForGovernmentContribution.description: False if not eligible (e.g. living overseas); default true

employeeRate.description: Employee contribution rate as a decimal: 0.035, 0.04, 0.06, 0.08 or 0.1

employerRate.description: Employer rate as a decimal; defaults to the 3.5% minimum
